justification: A keeps each failure cause at the branch site (Rejected(["payment-declined"])), prices with the same Try/out idiom the catalog already speaks, and reads as four linear guarded steps. B hides causes one hop away in adapter helpers behind three different unwrapping idioms (TryGetValue+TryGetErrors pairs, TryGetError, Match) with null-forgiving ! operators, _ discards, unreachable throw branches, and extra types (PricedLine, PromoEffect) that distance the reader from the rules.
